headline: PILOT DONE — StatusDot is drawn into the Figma staging copy (2VgBbVpKiDnu0aftJEVyBQ, page 'StatusDot', set 2003:21) by an agent, from the manifest, via the Figma MCP. 18 variants (6 tones x 3 sizes), named to the file's existing convention, fills bound to color/feedback/* and color/content/secondary, radius bound to radius/full, geometry deliberately left literal because the code sizes are raw Tailwind with no HDS token behind them (inventing statusDot/* variables would manufacture drift against ADR-025). Verified structurally (get_metadata) and visually (screenshot). The published library was never written to. Answer to the pilot question: the other 40 ARE mechanical, and the recipe is written down in figma/COMPONENT-DRAWING-RECIPE.md. THE REAL FIND: verifying the fills were genuinely variable-bound turned up that Figma's dark mode is entirely unwired — all 189 mode-aware variables (110 Semantic + 79 Component) are byte-identical in Light and Dark, while code ships a full [data-theme=dark] block (content.secondary neutral-600->neutral-400, feedback.success green-700->green-400). Filed #252. No component rework is implied: StatusDot binds to the right variables and will render dark correctly the moment the collections are fixed. Nothing caught it because check:figma-drift has never run against real state (#236). Walkthrough: docs/figma-statusdot-pilot-2026-09-21.html

#252 filed: Figma Light/Dark identical across 189 variables. Distinct from #245 (that is the code-side CSS emission bug); both say dark mode is the least-verified surface in the system
#253 filed: variant-grid ordering decision, with the Button evidence, defaulting 2026-10-05

Three Figma mechanics recorded so they are not rediscovered: a component set does not grow to fit its variants (resize BEFORE repositioning or the outer row/column is silently clipped); defaultVariant is positional, not child order; fills[0].color returns the BAKED colour so it cannot prove a binding is live — resolve valuesByMode through its alias chain instead
Confirmed the staging copy is a faithful duplicate: 50 pages, 339 variables across 3 collections. The Figma MCP reporting only a 'Cover' page is lazy page loading, not an empty file
